_README: FILL THIS IN AND SAVE YOUR COPY AS  var/roster.json
Do not edit this file in place -- it is tracked in git and holds no real
data. Your copy is not tracked: var/ and roster.json are both gitignored.
Any leftover REPLACE-ME is rejected on load rather than run with.
YOU DO NOT NEED ANYONE'S REAL NAME. If the group is pseudonymous, leave
'names' empty and fill in 'handles' instead. The tool now RUNS with an
empty roster -- it warns, records the gap in metrics.jsonl, and carries on.
Every field here improves coverage; none of them gate the pipeline.
handles -- the usernames members actually go by, as they appear in Signal.
This is the field that matters for a pseudonymous group. Copy each one
exactly; matching is case-insensitive, and a leading @ is optional.
A handle is matched as a WHOLE TOKEN and is never split on spaces, so
'Big Whale' will not cause every mention of 'whale' to be redacted.
Handles under 3 characters are ignored -- they would shred ordinary prose.
Handles feed redaction only. They are deliberately NOT given to the
egress firewall, and that is not an oversight: the firewall inspects the
whole outgoing request including this bot's own instructions, so a handle
that is an ordinary word ('gate', 'money', 'audit') would match the bot's
own text and fail every single window forever. Listing an ordinary-word
handle here is therefore SAFE -- worst case that word gets redacted out
of some research text.
names -- real names, ONLY if you genuinely know them. Usually leave empty.
Unlike handles these are enforced by the firewall too, because a real
name leaving the machine is worth failing a window over. Split forms are
generated for you: 'Anna Smith' also catches 'Anna' and 'Smith', and
possessives are handled. For that reason, do NOT put an ordinary word
here -- it can stall the pipeline in a way a handle cannot.
phones -- E.164 with country code, if you happen to know any. Optional.
Once listed, a number is caught in any written form: spaced, dashed,
bracketed, without the +, or in non-Latin numerals. Numbers NOT listed
are still caught whenever they are real, assignable numbers.
opted_out -- Signal ACI UUIDs of members who asked not to be included.
Leave as [] if nobody has. Takes the UUID, not the phone number.
An opt-out drops their messages at ingest AND any text of theirs that
someone else quotes.
group_name -- the group's display name, exactly as it appears in Signal.
Removed from anything sent, along with the group ID.
DON'T KNOW THE HANDLES YET? Start the receiver and let it watch for a while.
It records the display name Signal attaches to each sender into
var/observed-handles.json, so you can copy the ones you want into 'handles'
here. That file is local, gitignored, and an operator aid only -- nothing
reads it automatically, because a name harvested from the network should
not silently become a redaction rule.
THEN CHECK YOUR WORK WITHOUT SENDING ANYTHING:
docker compose --profile batch run --rm batch --dry-run
It prints the exact outbound payload and runs the egress firewall over
it. Read it yourself before letting it make a single live call.
